neighbours.label: the role or purpose filled right after a verb of appointing or choosing (appointed court painter, chosen as the State bird, commissioned to write)
fire: In 1820 she was appointed royal gardener to the queen.
The oak was chosen as the national tree of the country.
He was hired as chief engineer for the new railway.
The composer was commissioned to write a mass for the cathedral.
Lincoln named him ambassador to Russia in 1861.
The ship was selected to carry the president across the ocean.
She was elected chair of the committee last spring.
The town designated the old mill as a historic landmark.
quiet: In 1820 she worked in the gardens of the queen.
The oak grows tall in the forests of the country.
He spent years building the new railway.
The composer wrote a mass for the cathedral.
Lincoln met him in Washington in 1861.
The ship sailed across the ocean with the president.
She spoke at the committee meeting last spring.
The town restored the old mill near the river.

notes: Top: 'commissioned para', 'appointed the official musician for', 'vessel to carry', 'appointed court painter', 'chosen as the State bird', 'charged the architect with'. Near misses keep the people and things but drop the appointing.
